title: I know I am part of Apple's iPhone problem but even after doing all my research, I still don't feel the need to upgrade (AAPL)
text: I know I am part of Apple's iPhone problem but even after doing all my research, I still don't feel the need to upgrade (AAPL) By Nick Bastone Jan 20, 2019, 11:00 am 19 pts At the beginning of January, Apple announced that its holiday quarter revenue would be 7% lower than expected due to weakening iPhone sales. Not having upgraded my 7 Plus for over two years, I know I am part of Apple's iPhone problem. So, I made a trip to my local Apple Store and did some…
